lines.text: Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman born according to the flesh and one by the free woman born through the promise.
The women represent two covenants, and the covenant from Mount Carmel bears children into slavery, which is Hagar.
Hagar corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem because she is in slavery with her children, but the Jerusalem above is free.
Paul tells the brothers that, like Ishmael, they are children of promise.
The son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit, and believers are children of the free woman.
